name: Sphinx of the Revelation
oracle_text:
Flying, lifelink
Whenever you gain life, you get that many {E} (energy counters).
{W}{U}{U}, {T}, Pay X {E}: Draw X cards.

needs.what: an activated-ability cost "Pay X {E}" where X is announced on activation (bounded by the payer's energy, 0 allowed) and bound as `x` so the effect reads it -- the energy twin of `pay_life_x`/`discard_x`/`sacrifice_x`/`tap_x`, e.g. `{"pay_energy_x": true}`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `pay_energy` in cost_keys is a fixed integer; its mapping form is a value expression read only by a resolving `may` (Confiscation Coup), not an announced X. `x_value` fixes X from the board rather than letting the player choose it, and the ability has no {X} mana symbol to announce X through
